ऋअनम्: fanam, English spelling of Tamil paṇam; see paṇa. It was sometimes regarded as a gold coin equal to (1/10) of a partāb and (1/20) of a varāha (SII, Vol. I, p. 161).
fanam, Anglicised form of Tamil paṇam (q. v.); Sanskrit paṇa (q. v.); a gold coin equal to (1/20) of a varāha.
ऋअर्मान्: farmān, also spelt firmān; Persian; cf. phuramāṇa.
ऋद्धिपाद: ṛddhi-pāda, cf. iddhi-pāda (EI 5), Buddhist; four in number.
ऋणादायादिसम्बन्धवर्जित: ṛṇ-ādāy-ādi-sambandha-varjita (EI 23), refers to the free-dom of the gift land from confiscation for the realisation of debts incurred by the donee.
